name: Privatzimmer-Ferienwohnung Enzian
beschreibung: The Enzian holiday apartment is located in Thiersee, a small village in the Tiroler Unterland near the Bavarian border. The house is in a quiet location on the edge of the village, surrounded by meadows and mountains. Guests stay in a traditionally furnished holiday apartment with a separate entrance, kitchen, and balcony with mountain views. It is just a few minutes' walk to Thiersee, where you can swim. Hiking opportunities and cross-country ski trails in winter are nearby.
